trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_open_for_fuzzing","line":779,"var":"data","code":"return config_init_data(config, data, len - 1);","note":"The fuzzer input buffer is passed directly into the config parser, with len reduced by one to leave a sentinel byte."},
{"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_init_data","line":744,"var":"lexer.pos/end","code":".pos = data, .start = data, .end = (char *)data + len,","note":"Lexer boundaries are initialized from the attacker-controlled buffer, so parsing decisions depend on input bytes."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_config","line":459,"var":"chr","code":"if (chr == '\"' && !strncmp(lexer->pos, \"\"\"\", 2)) return lex_multiline_string;","note":"An input beginning with triple quotes selects the multiline-string lexer state."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string","line":341,"var":"end","code":"char *end = (peek(lexer) == '\"') ? \"\"\"\" : \"'''\";","note":"The lexer classifies the delimiter as double-quote multiline text and computes the terminating sequence."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string","line":345,"var":"lexer->pos","code":"do { if (!strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3)) { emit(lexer, LEXEME_STRING); lexer->pos += 3; return lex_config; } } while (next(lexer) != '\\0');","note":"If the closing triple quotes are missing, the lexer scans until EOF while repeatedly reading attacker-controlled bytes; this is the sink path that matches the reported crash state."}
]
